title: fix(runtime)!: the action and flow trigger doors refuse a body or params that is not a JSON object, through the resume door's shape check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XRNCtzAGvrxL3wfc8FMvK6L)_
Fixes #25976

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Contract review owed: the `(narrowing)` arm. The action door and the flow trigger doors refuse request shapes they used to dispatch: a body that is a string, number, boolean or array, and (action door) a `params` that is a string, number, boolean, array or `null`. Nothing is widened, and no `packages/spec/**` path is touched. The seat's claim (6411222289) carries `Clause-②: no`; the line above is the measured value on this diff, declared as the dispatch order asked.

## What changed

PR #25974 hoisted one value-shape check, `objectValueFailure(field, value)`, out of the resume door and made the trigger door ask it of `params`. Two neighbouring reads still coerced silently. This PR routes every run door's object-shaped input through that one function:

| Door | Read before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action`, `params` | `params && typeof params === 'object' ? params : {}`: a string became an empty bag, an array was handed on as the bag | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `{ field: 'params', code: 'invalid_type' }` |
| the same door, the body | `body && typeof body === 'object' ? body : {}`: a JSON string or array body ran with an empty bag | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `{ field: '(body)', code: 'invalid_type' }` |
| `buildAutomationContext` (both REST trigger routes and every declared `type: 'flow'` endpoint), the body | the same truthy-object guard: a string body dispatched with an empty bag, an array body reached the flat-body branch and forwarded its indices as params | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `{ field: '(body)', code: 'invalid_type' }` |
| `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/runs/:runId/resume`, the body | its own `typeof … !== 'object' \|\| Array.isArray(…)` check, a second spelling of the same question | the same refusal as before, now asked through `objectValueFailure`; its refusal sentence is byte-identical, and its `fields[]` message gains the `received …` suffix the other doors carry |

The check moved from `domains/automation.ts` to `packages/runtime/src/object-value-shape.ts`, beside `validation-failure.ts`. It gained one optional argument, `expected`, which only changes the wording: the resume body names its closed key set (`an object with inputs, variables, output, branchLabel`), every other caller gets `an object (a map of names to values)`. The judgement is one function, with no copy.

Absence keeps today's empty bag everywhere: no body, a JSON `null` body, and a body with no `params` key all dispatch as before. `undefined` counts as absent and an explicit `params: null` is refused, exactly as PR #25974 rules it for the trigger door's `params` and as the resume door rules `{"inputs":null}`.

Order is unchanged around the new refusal. On the action door it sits after the declaration lookup, the permission gate, the activation consult, the type check and the automation-service probe, and before the param contract, the record load and dispatch, so a caller who may not run the action still gets `403`/`404` first and a refused call reads no row. On the trigger doors it is where PR #25974 put the `params` refusal: after `404` and `403`, before `execute()`.

### Departure from the claim's wording, declared

The claim names the action door's `params`. The live probe on this branch found the action door's body read with the same truthy-object guard: `"oops"` and `[1,2]` as the whole body each answered `200` and started a run. It is the same defect class on the same door, in a file this claim already holds, closed with the same function and the same gate families, so it is fixed in place here (bounded in-place fix) rather than filed. The changeset and the tests cover it.

## Evidence

Live, fresh showcase boot (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`), signed in as the seeded admin, on this branch:

- `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/showcase_bulk_reassign` with `{"params":"oops"}`, `{"params":[1,2]}`, `{"params":null}`, `{"params":42}`: each `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `fields: [{ field: 'params', code: 'invalid_type', message: 'expected an object (a map of names to values), received a string' }]` (the received type varies). With the body `"oops"`, `[1,2]`, `42` (head `e321fc54`): each `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at `(body)`. Controls `{"params":{}}`, `{}` and `null` each `200` with a paused run. `GET /api/v1/automation/showcase_reassign_wizard/runs` afterwards listed exactly the control runs (2 on the first boot, 3 on the second): the refused calls left no run row.
- `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_notify_owner/trigger` and the legacy `POST /api/v1/automation/trigger/showcase_notify_owner`, each with the body `"oops"`, `[1,2]`, `42`, `true`: all eight `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at `(body)`; `{"params":"oops"}` still `400` naming `params`. Controls `null`, `{}` and `{"params":{}}` each dispatch (`400 FLOW_FAILED` "Unknown variable: ownerId", the flow's own answer with no inputs). `GET …/showcase_notify_owner/runs` afterwards: 6 runs, the six controls.
- Resume door, `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_reassign_wizard/runs/RUN_ID/resume` with `"oops"`, `[1,2]`, `42`: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, message `Invalid resume body — expected an object with inputs, variables, output, branchLabel, received a string` (backticked key names; byte-identical to `main`), `fields[0].message` now carrying the received type.

Tests (`packages/runtime/src/domains/run-door-input-shape.test.ts`, new; four rows added to `field-error-code-catalog.test.ts`'s census):

- Red first: with `domains/automation.ts` and `domains/actions.ts` restored from base `05f7758f`, the two files ran 78 failed / 59 passed (every refusal case red, every preservation case green).
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each anchor 1 to 0, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty), the same two files: action body check to `undefined`: 17 failed; action `params` check to `undefined`: 36 failed; trigger body check to `undefined`: 33 failed.
- Green at `e321fc54`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, 453 test files passed, 7399 tests passed, 19 skipped. The neighbouring suites (trigger params shape, resume value shape and envelope, trigger route status, caller param keys, record-load-denied action door, flow-start permissions, declarative update, flow input params) are inside that run and were also run alone before the merge: 11 files, 356/356.

Gates at `e321fc54`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 69 families against merge base `c8cb510a`; all 69 exit 0 (two needed the full build or an unshallow fetch and were green on this rerun). `--ran` reconciliation: 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `eslint --no-inline-config packages/runtime`: exit 0. Full `pnpm turbo run build` after the `origin/main` merge: 121/121 tasks.

Dogfood battery (the `(narrowing)` arm), full, at `e321fc54`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 1, Test Files 1 failed / 295 passed / 3 skipped (299), Tests 1 failed / 2522 passed / 18 skipped (2541). The one failure is not this diff's: `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` > `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts — every positive control is still present in THAT file`, control `handleI18nRequest` expected 3, received 4. `domains/i18n.ts` and the census file are byte-identical to `origin/main` on this branch (`git diff origin/main HEAD` empty for both), and `origin/main`'s `i18n.ts` carries 4 occurrences since `69fa23d6` (the ETag change), so this is a red on `main`'s full battery, reported to the seat rather than fixed here.

`origin/main` was merged once before opening (`c8cb510a`; none of its commits touch `domains/actions.ts`, `domains/automation.ts`, `endpoint-executor.ts` or `http-dispatcher.ts`).

## Acceptance notes

- The MCP `run_action` door reads `params` with the same truthy-object guard (`action-execution.ts`, `invokeBusinessAction`), but it is not reachable with a non-object value: measured on the same boot, `tools/call run_action` with `params: "oops"` and `params: [1,2]` is refused by the tool's own input schema (`-32602`, "expected record, received string at params"). Not touched.
- Other doors with their own body checks (`readActivationBody`, the toggle, run-lifecycle and clone bodies) already refuse a non-object body and are not run doors of this card; they keep their own wording.
- The new module lives in `packages/runtime/src/` rather than `src/domains/`: every file under `src/domains/` must be a declared dispatcher domain (`check:route-envelope`), and this one answers nothing. That is one path outside the claim's declared file surface (`packages/runtime/src/domains/**`).
